SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.title, p.content, p.user_id AS userId, u.name AS authorName, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.updated_at AS updated, p.is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, p.is_pinned AS isPinned, ct.name AS categoryName,
(SELECT post_id FROM posts WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND state = 'normal' AND post_id != p.post_id AND (view_count > p.view_count OR (view_count = p.view_count AND post_id > p.post_id)) ORDER BY view_count ASC, post_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS prevPostApi, (SELECT post_id FROM posts WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND state = 'normal' AND post_id != p.post_id AND (view_count < p.view_count OR (view_count = p.view_count AND post_id < p.post_id)) ORDER BY view_count DESC, post_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS nextPostApi
(SELECT MAX(post_id) FROM posts WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND state = 'normal' AND post_id < #{postId}) AS prevPostApi, (SELECT MIN(post_id) FROM posts WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND state = 'normal' AND post_id > #{postId}) AS nextPostApi
FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN categories ct ON p.category_id = ct.category_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.state = 'normal'
SELECT attachment_id AS attachmentId, file_name AS originName, file_size AS fileSize, file_url AS fileUrl FROM attachments WHERE post_id = #{postId}

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.content, u.name AS authorName, c.is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, c.is_private AS isPrivate, c.updated_at AS updated, c.user_id AS userId FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.state = 'normal' ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
